story_text:
## How To Choose Your PixelMob?
## Which Creator Are You?
## PixelMob Can Do Both For You
Whether you shoot for clients or for yourself, the friction shows up in the same three places. Offloading. Checking. Editing. Here is what changes when all three move into the field with you.
## For Creators Working with Clients
## For Creators Shooting for Themselves
From professional color grading and batch processing to focus stacking, HDR, and panorama stitching, PixelMob brings post-processing into your workflow with no additional subscription required.
Once your work is ready, you can download apps like Instagram and share it instantly, making it faster and easier to get your finished work out there.
## As Seen In
## Trusted by Creators
## Tested by Real Testers
## Powered by UnifyDrive
PixelMob is a creative sub-brand of UnifyDrive, backed by years of expertise in NAS, hardware, and intelligent data management.
Our previous product, UnifyDrive UT2, raised over $1 million on Kickstarter. Now, we're bringing that experience to PixelMob — built to help creators capture, manage, and create anywhere.
## What Your Next Shoot Looks Like
Picture the shoot where nothing waits. Cards offload as you work. Clients approve from the set. The first grade happens before you pack the car. That means less hardware to invest in, fewer software subscriptions to carry, and hours returned to the work itself.
## Store In One
Traditional workflows make you stop shooting to offload. Every card transfer breaks your rhythm or waits until the shoot ends. PixelMob supports tethering via USB-C, Wi-Fi, or Ethernet, keeping your files backed up in the background without interrupting your workflow.
With preset color grades, every saved photo is automatically rendered with your intended look, ready for review right away.
Different cameras, different cards, different connections. PixelMob automatically recognizes CFexpress Type A, CFexpress Type B, SD UHS-II, and microSD cards, with USB-A and USB-C support for even more ways to bring your media together. Everything flows into a single backup workflow, ready to edit.
Importing from several cards matters only if the data moves fast. CFexpress backup runs up to 800 MB/s, backing up 1TB in as little as thirty minutes. Your files are ready for review, editing, or delivery while you are still on site.
See the difference in a real-world 27GB backup speed test: PixelMob finished in 3:50, compared with 5:55 on a MacBook Pro.
You may already have data protection at the studio. Location work is where the gaps show. Accidental deletion, interrupted transfers, and storage failures all put footage at risk. PixelMob brings seven layers of protection into a portable workflow, wherever you shoot.
Beneath the interface, PixelMob is built with multiple layers of data protection engineered to safeguard your creative assets.
Long shoots drain everything. PixelMob carries up to 11,600mAh of built-in battery and accepts NP-F expansion, with intelligent power optimization and safety shielding for demanding outdoor production. It also reverse charges your cameras and devices.
*11,600mAh capacity and NP-F support on Pro. Standard features a 6,600mAh battery and does not support NP-F. NP-F batteries sold separately.
Reviewing 8K RAW on set demands real memory. PixelMob runs 12GB of high-speed RAM for smooth on-device preview, playback, and processing, so decisions happen on location instead of at home.
*The listed 12GB RAM is for the Pro. The Standard features 6GB RAM.
Reliable backup deserves real capacity. Dual M.2 2280 SSD slots and a mobile SSD expansion channel take PixelMob to 24TB, so large libraries stay protected and organized in one place.
*The listed 3-bay design (up to 24TB) is for Pro. The Standard features a 2-bay design (up to 8TB), supporting M.2 2242/2230 SSDs.
## Shoot In One
See, check, and record your shots right on set. PixelMob combines a bright, color-rich display with built-in recording capabilities, giving you a professional monitoring and recording solution wherever you shoot.
Preview every shot without being behind the camera. PixelMob lets directors, clients, and teammates view footage in real time, whether they are beside you or miles away, so feedback happens while you are still shooting.
## Create In One
Complete your first review and cull right on location. From massive RAW photo libraries to high-resolution 8K footage, PixelMob delivers smooth, responsive browsing and culling that shifts more of post-production into the field.
Thousands of similar frames, one pass. LightBox automatically groups bursts, time-lapses, similar images, and subjects, while recognizing people, birds, animals, and other visual content. It also flags blurry, overexposed, underexposed, blank, and abnormal shots. Swipe to keep or cull with instant RAW previews.
8K and Log footage slow down on-set review. FrameBox creates lightweight proxies with customizable settings while preserving timecode and audio. Add frame-accurate notes, voice memos, and markers to keep feedback organized.
*For details on supported camera models and file formats, please refer to the SSD and Camera Compatibility section.
Work directly with your original RAW files on PixelMob. Organize assets with IPTC and EXIF metadata, run professional grading, use AI-powered tools, and batch process multiple photos, all without exporting to a laptop.
Grade RAW files with official filters or custom presets. Auto-generated XMP sidecars ensure a seamless handoff to Lightroom or DaVinci Resolve.
Instantly apply your look to the entire batch, keeping visual consistency across your project in seconds.
Complex post-processing usually waits for a workstation. Powered by the RK3588 chip and the built-in Sequence compositing tool, PixelMob creates focus stacks, HDR images, panoramas, macro focus stacks, and star trails right where you shoot.
Connect over USB4, compatible with Thunderbolt 4, at up to 40Gbps and it becomes a high-speed local SSD. Edit and grade without transferring files.
*The listed USB4 (40Gbps) port is available on Pro only. Standard features a USB 3.2 Gen1 (5Gbps) port.
## Built for Long-Term Performance
Choose the connectivity that fits your workflow. PixelMob Pro offers a more comprehensive selection of professional I/O for demanding production setups, while PixelMob Standard covers essential everyday connections.
Sustained backup, 8K playback, and on-device compositing all put load on the system. An optimized cooling design keeps temperatures in check so performance stays consistent across long sessions in the field.
## Every Detail, Reconsidered
Every detail has been thoughtfully refined. The updated design introduces soft silicone corner protection, a repositioned logo, a dedicated battery protection cover, and an optimized cooling system, making PixelMob more durable and dependable for creators on the move.
*Earlier images may show engineering prototypes. Please refer to the latest images for the updated production design.
## Stretch Goal
More Rewards Await — Let's Unlock $1.2M Together!
Thanks to your incredible support, we've successfully unlocked our $800K Stretch Goal! Now, we're aiming for $1.2M to bring even more rewards to our backers!
$800K Stretch Goal: Unlocked!
All backers with reward pledges will receive a FREE Protective Storage Pouch ($39 value), compatible with both PixelMob Standard and Pro. Designed for everyday protection, it features a water-resistant exterior, soft interior cushioning, and a structured fit to protect your PixelMob from bumps and scratches.Pledges without rewards are not eligible.
$1.2M Stretch Goal: Next to Unlock!
Once we reach $1,200,000, eligible PixelMob Pro backers will receive a FREE PixelMob Unibody Charging Dock ($89 value) at no extra cost.
More than just a charging dock, it turns your PixelMob Pro into a desktop photo frame to display your favorite memories while charging. Crafted from precision-machined unibody aluminum with a black anodized finish, it features convenient drop-in charging, up to 45W charging output, and LED status indicators.
## More Reviews
## Production Update
## Production Is Underway
PixelMob is currently in small-batch assembly, and enough core components to fulfill campaign demand have already been manufactured. Product testing and certification work are progressing alongside assembly, with **mass production expected to begin in late October.
## Testing for Quality and Reliability
Every production unit will undergo 24 hours of high-temperature aging and stress testing, along with dozens of interface checks and dozens of software function tests, before being cleared for shipment.
Compared with the pre-production prototypes provided to testers, production units will feature improvements to the exterior design and cooling architecture.
## Shipping Outlook
Batch shipments are expected to begin in November, following assembly, testing, and final quality checks. Shipping arrangements for early and VIP backers will be shared once the fulfillment schedule is confirmed.
We’ll continue sharing production milestones and shipping progress through our Kickstarter Updates.
## Explore Your Packages
## PixelMob Add-ons
## After-Sales Services
## About PixelMob
PixelMob began with a simple question: how can creators back up, review, and share their photos and footage in the field — without carrying a laptop?
From early sketches to prototypes, we built PixelMob around real production needs: fast card offload the moment you stop shooting, on-device culling and editing, layered data protection, reliable power for a full shooting day, and a workflow made for creators on the move.
PixelMob debuted at NAB Show in April 2026, where creators and production professionals tested the workflow firsthand.
Their feedback helped us refine the product and prepare for our Kickstarter launch.
## Shipping Policy
The PixelMob project is entering mass production, with shipping expected from November 2026. Updates will be provided continuously.
For the regions listed below, all PixelMob Rewards include standard shipping, customs fees, and VAT. Optional add-ons also include standard shipping, customs fees, and VAT.
Kickstarter will automatically collect your perk payment within 7 days after the campaign ends. Afterward, we will collect your shipping information through the official Kickstarter survey and confirm fulfillment details based on your final delivery address.
## What's in the Box
## SSD and Camera Compatibility
A quick view of supported SSDs, cameras, photo formats, and video files. For detailed information, please check the full list here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aKGM-QadC_x92mdyjyw1kd1HMUtmlohlX-Nob_KddJM/edit?gid=0#gid=0
## Specifications
## Project Timeline
## Follow Us
risks: We want to be upfront: like any crowdfunding project, bringing PixelMob from working prototypes to mass production involves risks and uncertainties. However, this is not our team’s first experience developing and delivering high-performance hardware. As a specialized brand under UnifyDrive, PixelMob is built by data-system and hardware veterans with experience in storage architecture, product engineering, manufacturing, and global fulfillment. This background gives us confidence in managing challenges involving component supply, product optimization, quality control, certification, and logistics. Part of what makes Kickstarter special is that you are not simply a customer—you are part of the journey. Throughout final development, manufacturing, certification, and fulfillment, we will communicate openly and consistently, sharing progress, test results, challenges, and any material changes to specifications or delivery estimates. Your trust matters to us, and we are committed to delivering a PixelMob product that creators can rely on in the field and in the studio. The product demonstrations, interface recordings, prototype photographs, manufacturing images, and performance tests shown throughout this campaign feature real PixelMob hardware and actual development work.

faq.q: There are two models—how do I know which one to pick?
faq.a:
- Pro Version (The Ultimate Workstation): The absolute "Pro" choice. Features a gorgeous 7-inch AMOLED screen (up to 1,100 nits peak brightness, 99% sRGB/Rec.709), 3x full-size M.2 2280 SSD slots supporting up to a massive 24TB capacity, and full high-performance workflows.
- Standard Version (Compact & Powerful): Best for light and mobile setups. Features a highly efficient 5.5-inch AMOLED screen and 2x M.2 2230/2242 SSD slots supporting up to 8TB capacity.

Plus, we also offer dedicated access…

faq.q: What countries/regions can PixelMob be shipped to? Is there a shipping fee?
faq.a:
We operate three overseas warehouses around the world, enabling global shipping coverage. PixelMob ships to all supported countries and regions with FREE shipping — no extra fees at checkout. See the 【Shipping Policy】 section for the full list of supported destinations.

Wherever you are, we'll make sure PixelMob reaches your doorstep — get ready!

faq.q: What is the warranty of PixelMob?
faq.a:
We stand behind the quality of our products and services. PixelMob Standard and PixelMob Pro both include a 2-year warranty for your peace of mind.
For warranty coverage: main unit and SSD come with a 2-year warranty; NP-F battery (Pro version only) comes with a 1-year warranty.
If you need further assistance, feel free to contact us via: support@pixelmob.ai

faq.q: How can I contact you if I have more questions?
faq.a:
We're here to help! You can contact us anytime by email at support@pixelmob.ai, and our team will get back to you within 48 hours.
You can also reach out to us on our Facebook Group via the following link for quick responses and updates: https://www.facebook.com/groups/1005341999007455

faq.q: What is the shipping time for PixelMob?
faq.a:
Shipping to our overseas warehouses will begin in November 2026 for both PixelMob Pro and PixelMob(Standard). Due to Kickstarter rules, local delivery can only start after the campaign ends.
After the campaign, we will send a survey to collect your shipping information and arrange delivery. For the latest updates on shipping, please stay tuned to our Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/1005341999007455

https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005066393-How-do-I-pledge

faq.q: What forms of payment can I use to make a pledge?
faq.a:
To pledge to our project you can use a debit or credit card associated with Visa, Discover, JCB, MasterCard, UnionPay, or American Express. At this time, Discover, UnionPay, and JCB cards are only accepted for US-based projects. We do not currently accept Maestro or Visa Electron cards.
If you are going to use a prepaid credit card, please make sure that the card has a value of at least 1 USD (or the equivalent in your local currency, e.g. 1 GBP) more than the amount of your pledge. This will he…

According to Kickstarter's policy, you can cancel your pledge in your account before the project ends. If the project has ended and pledge collection has started, it is no longer possible to cancel. Additionally, you will only be charged after the project has ended.
If you have any questions, please contact us via: support@pixelmob.ai
Feel free to follow the guide from Kickstarter: https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005133013-Can-I-cancel-a-pledge-
Your card will be charged upon the end of the campaign.

faq.q: How do I provide my shipping address and reward details?
faq.a: We will send you a survey to collect the necessary information we need to fulfill rewards as soon as our project ends. For more details, please check https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005126894-How-do-I-provide-a-creator-with-my-shipping-address-and-reward-details-

faq.q: How can I change my pledge amount or reward selection?
faq.a: Customers can adjust pledge amounts or switch to a different reward tier by visiting the project page. Additionally, you will have the option to add any add-on rewards. For more information, please check out: https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005126814-How-can-I-change-my-pledge-amount-or-reward-selection-

faq.q: Can I pledge to the project more than once?
faq.a:
According to Kickstarter's policy, it is only possible to pledge to a project once. Accordingly, backers can only choose one reward tier and add-on accessories per pledge. Please feel free to contact us via support@pixelmob.ai first to seek a personalized arrangement.
For more information, please check: https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005132333-Can-I-pledge-to-a-single-project-more-than-once-

Sorry that PayPal is not available as a payment method on Kickstarter, but there are other options that you can use. Kickstarter currently accepts payments from direct credit or debit cards. For more payment details, please check: https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/articles/11500506

faq.q: Why do I receive a notification that “Crowdfunding is not shopping”? So am I guaranteed with shipping?
faq.a: The notification you received is a standard disclaimer present on all crowdfunding platforms. It serves as a reminder of the unique nature of crowdfunding campaigns compared to regular shopping experiences. Our commitment is to deliver on time, and we'll continue to provide real-time updates on production and shipping progress.
